name: Quote
title: Quote
summary: Three quotation blocks: a large Lora pull quote, a testimonial card with avatar, and a scripture quote with a gold rule, verse numbers and a full reference.
whenToUse: Pull quote: one powerful listener or partner story inside a long page or between sections.
Testimonial card: partner and listener voices in a grid of two or three.
Scripture quote: any Bible verse shown on a page, light or dark.
whenNotToUse: Do not use Lora anywhere else: Lora is for scripture and quotes only.
Do not put more than one pull quote on a screen.

props.name: children
props.description: The quote text, under about 35 words. Trim with an ellipsis rather than shrinking the type.

props.name: author
props.description: Person's name, shown bold in the caption.

props.name: byline
props.description: Role and place after the name ("Radio Hope listener, Addis Ababa").

props.name: quoteLang
props.description: Language of the quote when it is not the page language (`lang="am"`).

variantNotes: Pull quote: Lora 34px, gold “ mark (`--gradient-gold`), 64px `.thread` gradient rule, Inter caption.
Testimonial: base `.card` (20px radius, `--shadow-card-light`), 18px Inter quote, `.dp-av-56` avatar, name 16px/600, role · place 14px `--gray-600`.
Scripture light: white panel, `--gray-200` border, 3px `--gradient-gold` rule, Lora 22px, verse numbers `--horizon-blue-dim`.
Scripture dark `.dp-scripfig-dark`: `--charcoal-900` panel, `--leather-gold` rule, white text, verse numbers `--blue-on-dark`.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Use `--font-serif` (Lora) for pull and scripture text only; captions and references stay in Inter.
Give the reference in full (book, chapter:verse) and the translation abbreviation (BSB).
Verse numbers are superscript `.dp-sv`, Inter 600, never Lora.
Quote a real person with consent; give name, role and place. Never invent a testimonial and present it as genuine.
Keep a pull quote under about 35 words; trim with an ellipsis rather than shrinking the type.
Do not italicise scripture; Lora regular is the house style.

accessibility: Use `<figure>`, `<blockquote>` and `<figcaption>` so the source is tied to the quote.
The quote mark, gold rule and thread are decorative: `aria-hidden="true"`.
Avatar beside the visible name uses `alt=""`.
Set `lang` on the blockquote when it is not in the page language (`lang="am"` for Amharic).
content: Warm, first-person, specific: who heard, where, in which language.
Scripture defaults to the Berean Standard Bible (BSB), free to share.
